syntax.plot:
One curve or option per line:
y = x^2 - 1 or x = cos(t), y = sin(t)
domain: -5, 5 and point: 1, 0, Root
syntax.csv:
Rows of values, and the first row is the header:
Run, Ratio
Or read a file with path: assets/results.csv
syntax.typst:
A Typst snippet, drawn as an image:
$ E = m c^2 $
Packages from the internet are not available.
syntax.mermaid:
A Mermaid diagram, for example:
flowchart LR
A --> B
syntax.d2:
A D2 diagram, for example:
client -> server: request
server.shape: cylinder
syntax.svg:
One svg element, for example:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" /></svg>
Scripts, links and remote images are removed.
syntax.html:
A full HTML page or a fragment with CSS and scripts.
It has no internet access, so put your data in the block.
Scripts start when you click Run.
syntax.smiles:
One SMILES string per line, with an optional name:
Aspirin: CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O
Up to 24 per block.
syntax.molecule:
Option lines first, such as format: pdb and style: cartoon.
Then the file text, or path: assets/1abc.pdb
syntax.sequence:
FASTA records or a raw sequence:
>sample 1
ATGGCCATTGTAATG
syntax.notebook:
The notebook's path on the first line:
assets/analysis.ipynb
Then optional lines such as cells: 2-5 and code: hide.
syntax.bookmark:
One field per line, starting with the web address:
url: https://example.com/article
Then optional title:, description:, image:, site: and favicon: lines.

replacements.description: Swaps pairs like -> for → while you type. Code and math stay as typed, and Backspace right after a swap puts your text back.
replacements.empty: No pairs yet. Add one below.
replacements.full: You can have up to {{limit}} pairs. Remove one to add another.

keepUndo.label: Keep undo after closing
keepUndo.description: Undo still works on a note after you close it or quit the app. The history stays on this computer, and turning this off deletes it.

tikzPreamble.label: TikZ preamble
tikzPreamble.description: Lines such as \usetikzlibrary{positioning} that start the preamble of every TikZ and CircuiTikZ block.

codeFont.label: Code font
codeFont.description: Pick an installed font for code blocks and inline code.

codeTheme.label: Code block colors
codeTheme.description: Pick the syntax colors for code blocks in notes.

accent.label: Note accent color
accent.description: Used for links, tags and task boxes in notes.
accent.customAriaLabel: Pick a custom note accent color

callouts.label: Callout style
callouts.description: How callout boxes look in notes.

fieldStyle.label: Date and field chips
fieldStyle.description: How dates and fields like due or priority look in notes.

remoteImages.title: Images from the web
remoteImages.description: Notes and assistant replies load images from these sites without asking.
remoteImages.empty: Notes and assistant replies ask before they load an image from the web. Sites you always allow appear here.

notesPreview.label: Preview of a note with these settings

notesPreview.highlight: Seedlings doubled in height in one week.
notesPreview.calloutBody: Check the soil sensors before taking new samples.

quickCapture.title: Quick capture
quickCapture.failed: Couldn't save this. Your text is still here, so you can try again.
